newsitem.title: FINLAND: ASPO SAYS MAY FACE EXTRA TAX DEMAND.
newsitem.headline: ASPO SAYS MAY FACE EXTRA TAX DEMAND.

text.p: Finnish chemicals group Aspoyhtyma Oy said in a statement on Friday tax authorities were demanding a change in the group's 1994 taxation, which could cause a 60 to 80 million markka additional tax for the group.
"Aspoyhtyma Oy and Polttoaine Oy will in their responses challenge Helsinki tax authority's demand," Aspoyhtyma said.
The demand from Helsinki tax ombudsman concerns taxation of the merger of Aspo Oy and Oy Troili Ab in 1994, through which the group's complicated structure was streamlined, it said.

"The ombudsman's demand could mean a 60 to 80 million markka additional tax charge to be paid for the above mentioned measures, through which the group's structure was streamlined to its current form," Aspoyhtyma said.
